title: Quality Analyst
description:
**Experience : 3 to 5 Years**

What you’ll do

● Review requirements, user stories, and designs; identify gaps, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

● Plan and perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and user acceptance testing.

● Build and maintain automated tests for critical user journeys across web and mobile.

● Test APIs and backend workflows, including request validation, responses, error handling, and data consistency.

● Test Salesforce features and workflows, including record creation and updates,permissions, automation, reports, and integrations.

● Validate end-to-end scenarios such as registration, profile and credential updates, job search, applications, recruiter interactions, and status changes.

● Verify data flows between the product, Salesforce, and connected services; investigate sync failures and duplicate or missing records.

● Track test cases, defects, and QA work in Jira; write clear, reproducible bug reports and verify fixes.

● Collaborate with developers to reproduce issues and improve testability.

● Maintain test plans, test cases, automation suites, and release quality notes.

● Participate in release readiness reviews and help the team make risk-based testing decisions.

● Consider accessibility, usability, privacy, and security in day-to-day testing.

What you’ll bring

● 3+ years of experience in software QA, including both manual and automation testing.

● Experience testing web applications and REST APIs.

● Hands-on experience with an automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.

● Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent.

● Salesforce testing experience, ideally with Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.

● Understanding of Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, profiles and permissions, Flows, reports, and integration behavior.

● Practical experience using Jira to manage defects, test work, and project workflows.

● Ability to write clear test scenarios and communicate defects with useful steps, expected results, and actual results.

● Familiarity with SQL or another method of validating application data.

● Understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile practices, and CI/CD workflows.

● Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize testing based on user and business impact.

Good to have

● Experience testing mobile applications or responsive web experiences.

● Experience with healthcare, recruiting, staffing, or job marketplace products.

● Familiarity with AI-enabled features, including conversational search and recommendations.

● Experience with Salesforce integration testing, such as REST APIs, middleware, or event-driven data flows.

● Familiarity with accessibility and cross-browser testing.

Pay: From ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment

Work Location: In person

title: Associate – Java
description:
Gandhinagar Full-time 4-5 yrs

  

* Experience4–5 years
* LocationGIFT City, Gandhinagar
* QualificationB.Tech or B.E., B.C.A. prior to M.C.A.
* Shift10:00 AM to 6:30 PM

**Role Overview**
-----------------

**Mid-Level Java Backend Engineer.** We are seeking a Java Backend Engineer to develop, maintain, deploy, and support enterprise backend services for identity, authentication, user-profile, session, and OTP-based workflows. The role involves working on business-critical REST APIs, secure authentication flows, database operations, messaging integrations, and production deployments on JBoss/WildFly.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and maintain Java-based REST APIs for user registration, authentication, profile management, password updates, session handling, and administrative operations.
* Build and support secure authentication mechanisms including JWT, API credentials, OTP/MFA flows, token validation, token refresh, and logout.
* Develop and maintain OTP generation, verification, expiry, retry/failed-attempt, and notification-delivery workflows.
* Write and optimize SQL queries and JDBC-based data-access components for MySQL databases.
* Integrate backend services with Apache Kafka and external HTTP-based enterprise systems.
* Deploy, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot WAR applications on JBoss/WildFly.
* Manage application-server concerns including JNDI datasource configuration, deployment setup, logs, runtime configuration, and release support.
* Investigate production issues using application/server logs, request IDs, database records, Kafka messages, and API traces.
* Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and improve code quality and reliability.
* Create and maintain API documentation, technical documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Follow secure coding practices while handling customer identity, authentication, and sensitive data.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* 4–5 years of hands-on Java backend development experience.
* Strong core Java knowledge, including collections, exception handling, concurrency fundamentals, streams, and secure coding practices.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs using JAX-RS, Jersey, RESTEasy, Spring Boot, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with Java EE/Jakarta EE concepts, including CDI, EJB, Servlets, JAX-RS, and WAR deployments.
* Hands-on experience deploying and supporting applications on JBoss/WildFly or similar Java application servers.

title: Senior Python Backend / Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Advertisement**  
Senior Python Backend / Platform Engineer

**Econexa Solutions Private Limited**

Econexa Solutions Private Limited is seeking an experienced **Senior Python Backend / Platform Engineer** to support and enhance an established, confidential web platform.

The role focuses on backend development, API integrations, database management, automated testing, troubleshooting, security, and final platform improvements. We are looking for a technically strong engineer who can work confidently within an existing codebase and deliver reliable, well-tested solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and optimise Python backend services.
* Design, integrate, and troubleshoot REST APIs.
* Manage Supabase and PostgreSQL databases, authentication, storage, permissions, and data access.
* Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot backend services on Render.
* Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, and regression tests.
* Work with Git, GitHub pull requests, CI pipelines, and code reviews.
* Implement secure access controls, audit trails, and reliable data-handling practices.
* Diagnose technical issues and deliver focused, maintainable code improvements.
* Document changes, testing outcomes, and technical decisions.

Required Skills & Experience

* Strong professional experience in Python backend development.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs, Supabase, and PostgreSQL.
* Experience deploying and managing applications on Render.
* Proficiency in automated testing and debugging.
* Strong understanding of Git/GitHub workflows and CI checks.
* Knowledge of secure application architecture, permissions, and data integrity.
* Ability to work independently within an existing software platform.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with multi-tenant web applications and complex business workflows.
* Experience testing file uploads, version-controlled records, and end-to-end user journeys.
* Familiarity with frontend development using the platform's existing framework.

Ideal Candidate

A senior engineer with strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a testing-first mindset who can identify issues, improve platform reliability, and deliver clearly documented, verified solutions.

**Project details will be shared with selected candidate only.**

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹350,000.00 per year
